name: @ovelle/desktop

scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never && node ../../scripts/repack-mac.mjs x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never && node ../../scripts/repack-mac.mjs arm64
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:all: npm run package:mac:x64 && npm run package:mac:arm64 && npm run package:windows

description: Ovelle desktop application for FBLA Coding & Programming
author: Ovelle
